source.title: New Delhi metallo-β-lactamase-1 in Enterobacteriaceae: emerging resistance

source_type_guardrail.finding: The source is a narrative review rather than primary literature.
source_type_guardrail.handling: Review methods and author statements are atomized as review-level claims. Results attributed to cited studies are tagged secondary_reported_result and remain anchored to the review pages. No cited study is represented as though this review enrolled participants or generated the underlying data.

schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom model has no dedicated secondary_review_claim or guideline_recommendation kind. Review-level secondary findings use existing kinds plus descriptive tags.
QuantitativeResult has no first-class field for MIC50 or MIC90 alongside susceptibility percentage; MIC values are preserved in canonical statements, exposure details, and original_result_text.
Reported susceptibility ranges across two breakpoint systems are stored as interval_type=range while the numeric estimate field carries the lower bound; tags mark range_as_reported.
extraction_limitations: The review used only 4 of 23 identified research articles and applied subjective credibility selection; the atom set therefore reflects the review, not a complete 2010 NDM-1 evidence base.
Most empirical findings are secondary reports. Primary-study atoms require separate extraction of the cited papers.
All atoms remain needs_review because no human source-verification step is represented.
The governing SEA file is named v4 but its internal heading says Integrated Compact v3. The v4-named file governed by project precedence; the label conflict was not silently repaired.
